dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five distinct 'O' shaped annuli located on the posterior-lateral flank, characterized by sharp high-contrast outer perimeters transitioning to a lighter grey-white interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of irregular, high-intensity white blobs concentrated along the mid-dorsal ridge and upper lateral flank, characterized by a lack of internal gradients and a jagged, fragmented spatial distribution.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent posterior 'O' rings form an irregular quadrilateral; three prominent blobs on the mid-dorsal ridge form an obtuse triangle relative to the longitudinal axis of the visible body.
